rationale: The agent properly authenticated the user (name + zip matched a single account), verified the order details, and obtained explicit confirmation before making changes. However, it executed the return first, which changed the order status to “return requested” and prevented the exchange from being processed—even though the user explicitly wanted both and preferred the exchange if only one could be done. As a result, the requested exchange was not completed, and the agent’s sequence of actions caused the failure. While the agent gave accurate information afterward and guided the user to place a new order, it did not complete the original request in line with the user’s stated preference and the system’s capabilities prior to the return action.
